run_dqn_experiment: run a DQN agent experiment on the scavenger environment with configurable episodes and output path
create_scavenger_environment: create a scavenger environment using get_fig5_task_config and EnvironmentWithLogging wrapper
build_dqn_agent: build a DQN agent with AdamOptimizer and configurable network output sizes for the environment
run_experiment_loop: run the experiment loop with a DQN agent and report EMA returns every N episodes
write_returns_to_file: write the EMA returns from a completed experiment to a specified output file path
